PURGE.summary: Permanently deletes a namespace that was marked as removed, together with its nested namespaces.
PURGE.complexity: O(N) where N is the number of nested namespaces and buckets under the namespace. Waits up to 5 seconds for all members to observe the removal.

arguments.name: namespace
arguments.summary: Dot-separated hierarchical path of the namespace to purge, for example staging.orders. The namespace must be marked as removed first with NAMESPACE REMOVE.
